figures.Fig10.5: Figure 10.5 Measuring the standard electrode potential of a Cu2+/Cu half-cell (PDF page 227). Original figure archived as c11-chem-ch10-fig-cu-vs-she (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The printed figure draws the arrows on the connecting wire pointing from the copper (+) electrode to the hydrogen electrode (-) electrode while labelling the wire e-; electrons flow from the negative to the positive terminal, so the arrows are drawn from hydrogen electrode (-) to copper (+) (correct).
